title: 7.2 Feelings and Needs
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Handle basic physical needs, weather, clothing, leisure, invitations, and requests for help.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Recognize five common states and answer How are you? with I am + state.
grammar_function: How are you? I am + adjective.
prerequisite: 3.1 greetings, 3.3 am/is/are; Unit 1 states/actions; Unit 5 food and needs.
speaking_outcome: Ask How are you? and say I am happy/sad/tired/hungry/thirsty.

cards.pedagogy_note: Answer pattern with known I am.
Uses a generic proven instruction, only previously taught questions, and makes the state question the sole scene fit.
Removes the untaught question Who are you?.
